sent:
Liam —

Here’s the concrete one‑pager for your devs plus a head‑to‑head test plan.

Dev one‑pager (campaign join page)
Goal
- Maximise same‑day paid joins from paid clicks. First screen carries promise and price; no detours.

URL and routing
- Dedicated URL (e.g. /join-offer?jan). Do not index.
- Send paid traffic for this offer to that URL only; keep /join for organic/site nav.

Hero (above the fold)
- Headline: “Join for £1.”
- Subhead: “Instant email. Access card in 5 minutes during staffed hours.”
- Location first, inline: [Postcode] → [Club dropdown] (auto‑suggest nearest if you can).
- Primary CTA: “Start in 60 seconds.” One CTA only.
- Price line under CTA: “Pay today: £1 + joining fee £0/£15 (this club). No contract.”
- Remove global nav and secondary CTAs on this page; place a muted “Prefer a tour?” link below the fold.

Flow order (single, linear)
1) Confirm club → 2) Choose plan (preselect the plan that matches the ad) with Today’s total visible → 3) Details → 4) Card.
- Move upsells (PT, sauna) post‑payment or into the welcome email.
- Progress labels: “Choose club • Plan • Pay”.

Staffed‑hours promise
- If within staffed hours for the chosen club: “Staffed now: collect card in 5 minutes.”
- Else: “Collect during staffed hours: [next staffed window]” (or a clear rule if live hours aren’t available).

Local proof (still visible on first screen on mobile)
- 2–3 short reviews from the selected club only. Fallback to generic if fewer than two.

Friction trims specific to your current /join
- Resolve price before form fields: show Today’s total immediately after club selection.
- Keep DOB and full address where they are, but only after Today’s total; enable postcode lookup to shorten typing.
- On paid sessions, suppress the 7‑Day Pass path entirely on the campaign page to avoid cannibalising the offer.

Tracking (use these names as‑is)
- PageViewOffer {ab_variant, club_id}
- StartJoinClicked {club_id, club_name, utm_source, utm_campaign, ab_variant}
- ClubSelected {club_id, club_name, postcode_partial, ab_variant}
- PlanSelected {plan_id, plan_name, today_total_gbp, joining_fee_gbp, ab_variant}
- PaymentCompleted {value_gbp, club_id, plan_id, ab_variant, utm_source, utm_campaign, transaction_id}
Counting rule: decide on paid joins and CPA only; attribute PaymentCompleted to the last eligible paid click in‑session; carry ab_variant through checkout and fire it with PaymentCompleted.

UI/performance notes
- Mobile first; large tap targets; numeric keypad for number fields; labels outside inputs; inline, specific errors.
- One hero image (compressed), inline critical CSS for the first screen; defer everything non‑essential.

A/B test plan (/join vs campaign page)
Variants
- A: Current /join (unchanged).
- B: New campaign page above, handing into the same payment step (or a mirrored flow) so PaymentCompleted is identical across both.

Traffic and assignment
- 50/50 split on paid traffic only. One destination per ad concept; no mixing.
- Append ?ab=a / ?ab=b, set a first‑party cookie/session, and persist ab_variant to checkout and PaymentCompleted.

Metrics and guardrails
- Primary: Paid‑join rate per paid click; CPA = paid spend ÷ paid joins.
- Secondary: Drop‑off from StartJoinClicked to PaymentCompleted; median time to complete.
- Freeze promo copy, pricing and fees during the test window; keep creative consistent per concept and destination.
- Run long enough to cover weekday/weekend behaviour; don’t stop on a single day’s swing.

Reporting (daily)
- For each variant and per club: paid clicks, paid joins, join rate, spend, CPA. Include ab_variant in every export to sanity‑check routing.

Directional yardsticks (context, not promises)
- Oatside Kitchen: cost per first order down 38% after moving ads off the homepage onto focused offer pages.
- Tallow & Thyme: 4.8% conversion on a focused finder vs 1.9% on the product grid.
- Glow Theory: ROAS 1.6 → 3.1 over two 90‑day blocks once creative testing and new pages worked together.

Creative note
- Keep the exact same on‑frame line across formats: “Join for £1. Start in 60 seconds.” One destination per concept keeps the read honest. If safe‑margin overlays for 9:16, 4:5 and 1:1 would help your team, I can include them in a PDF version.

If you want this as a single‑page PDF checklist your devs can tick off, say the word and I’ll package it cleanly with example copy blocks and safe‑margin overlays.
